title: Is there a connection between a number and its fewest clicks?
description: A question from the book asks for a connection between each number and its fewest button clicks. The video adds the digits of each of five numbers, compares them with the clicks found before, and finds that they always match.
teaching_notes: One idea: the fewest clicks of a number equal its digits added together. Ask the class to add the digits of each number before looking back at the clicks. Watch for students who add the digits of a number with a zero and forget that zero adds nothing.

video_script.why: The child has found the fewest clicks for five numbers by adding the clicks of every button.
video_script.substitution: Add the digits of the number and compare the total with its fewest clicks.
video_script.anchor: Is there a connection between each number and its fewest number of button clicks?
video_script.payoff_line: The smallest number of clicks is the sum of the digits of the number

final_answer.value: The smallest number of clicks is the sum of the digits of the number
final_answer.spoken: the smallest number of clicks is the sum of the digits of the number

hold_back: sum of the digits of the number
maths_rules: check: the digits added match the clicks of the previous question for all five numbers
video_script.design: One idea: the fewest clicks match the digits added. Add the digits of each number, then check against the earlier clicks. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to find the connection between each number and its clicks.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, take eight thousand three hundred. Its digits are eight, three, zero and zero.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Added together they make eleven, the same as its clicks.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Next, forty thousand six hundred twenty nine. Its digits are four, zero, six, two and nine.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Added together they make twenty one, again the same as its clicks.

marks.m1: the digits of 56354 are added to 23
marks.m2: the digits of 66666 are added to 30

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, take fifty six thousand three hundred fifty four. Its digits are five, six, three, five and four, adding to twenty three.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Sixty six thousand six hundred sixty six has five sixes, which add to thirty.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Next, three lakh sixty seven thousand eight hundred thirteen.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Its digits are three, six, seven, eight, one and three, adding to twenty eight.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, check against the clicks we found before. Eleven, twenty one, twenty three, thirty and twenty eight all match.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Not one number breaks the pattern.
